name: Next Time On...Oddly Specific Hospital
source:
A visual novel where you play as Jonathan, an actor on a new medical soap opera. Jonathan doesn't know his lines. Choose the direction of the story and try not to anger the director!

[From [url=https://jcharrison12.itch.io/next-time-on-oddly-specific-hospital]Itch.io[/url]]
